**Crate:** `vox-crypto` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

Pure-Rust crypto primitives (chacha20poly1305 AEAD, ed25519, x25519); sole crypto SSOT per AGENTS.md §Cryptography Policy.
